LAW AND MOTION, 301, NO APPEARANCES ON THIS MATTER. THE COURT ADOPTED ITS TENTATIVE RULING AS FOLLOWS: DEFENDANT CONSTANCE CARTER'S MOTION FOR SUMMARY JUDGMENT IS OFF CALENDAR AS MOVING PARTY NOTICED THE HEARING FOR LESS THAN 30 DAYS BEFORE THE MAY 23, 2011 TRIAL DATE WITHOUT AN ORDER OF THE COURT FOR GOOD CAUSE IN CONTRAVENTION OF C C P 437 C(A) AND AS MOVING PARTY FAILED TO PROVIDE DEPARTMENT 301 WITH ENDORSED-FILED COURTESY COPIES OF THE MOVING PAPERS AS REQUIRED BY LOCAL RULE 2.6(B). JUDGE: PETER J. BUSCH, REPORTER: CAROL KAREN, CSR # 8189 301/PJB

LAW AND MOTION, 301, NO APPEARANCES ON THIS MATTER. THE COURT ADOPTED ITS TENTATIVE RULING AS FOLLOWS: DEFENDANT CONSTANCE CARTER'S MOTION FOR JUDGMENT ON THE PLEADINGS IS OFF CALENDAR AS MOVING PARTY NOTICED THE HEARING AFTER THE DATE FOR WHICH THE CASE WAS INITIALLY SET FOR TRIAL (12/20/10) IN CONTRAVENTION OF C C P 438 (E) AND AS MOVING PARTY FAILED TO PROVIDE DEPARTMENT 301 WITH ENDORSED-FILED COURTESY COPIES OF THE MOVING PAPERS AS REQUIRED BY LOCAL RULE 2.6 (B). JUDGE: PETER J. BUSCH, REPORTER: CAROL KAREN, CSR # 8189 301/PJB
